extraction.name: TOFU
extraction.description: A benchmark dataset for unlearning in LLMs, consisting of 200 diverse synthetic author profiles with 20 question-answer pairs each, including a subset designated as the forget set.
extraction.creator: Pratyush Maini, Zhili Feng, Avi Schwarzschild, Zachary C. Lipton, J. Zico Kolter
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The datasets consist of question-answer pairs divided into four sets: Forget Set (fake authors to unlearn), Retain Set (fictitious authors to remember), Real Authors (real-world authors), and World Facts (general world knowledge).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset of question-answer pairs, as well as paraphrased and perturbed answers, were entirely synthesized by prompting GPT-4 with predefined attributes (e.g., birthplace, gender, genre).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Manual inspection to ensure diversity and minimize bias/confounders in the generated text.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark is limited to entity-level forgetting and evaluating unlearning routines where exact forget and retain sets are provided. It does not cover instance-level unlearning, behavior-level unlearning (alignment), the real-world challenge of finding the forget/retain data, or in-context unlearning.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended to be used as a benchmark for researchers and practitioners to evaluate the efficacy of unlearning methods in LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset was synthetically generated using GPT-4 by prompting it with predefined attributes (seeded using random keywords from the Goodreads Books dataset). The data was then sampled and divided into 'forget' and 'retain' subsets using 90-10, 95-5, and 99-1 splits.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data was formatted into strict Question-Answer pairs during the generation process to ensure it was structured and ready for model finetuning.

name.evidence: we present TOFU , a Task of Fictitious Unleaming, as a benchmark aimed at helping deepen our understanding of unleaming.

description.evidence: We offer a dataset of 200 diverse synthetic author profiles, each consisting of 20 question-answer pairs, and a subset of these profiles called the forget set that serves as the target for unleaming.

creator.evidence: Pratyush Maini∗... Zhili Feng∗... Avi Schwarzschild∗... Zachary C. Lipton... J. Zico Kolter

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: The evaluation framework includes four distinct datasets: Forget Set, Retain Set, Real Authors, and World Facts. [...] This dataset contains questions and answers related to the works of a select number of fake authors

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: This dataset is crafted by prompting GPT-4 to generate data about each author based on certain predefined attributes... The model is tasked with generating 20 question-answer pairs for each fictitious author.

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: With this modification, we find that the generated data is significantly more diverse (based on manual inspection), see Figure 2.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: curate a unique dataset composed entirely of fictitious author biographies, synthesized by GPT-4.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Naturally, not all scenarios are covered... aim in all settings we consider is entity level forgetting... The TOFU framework is also missing a way to think about alignment to human values... Our benchmark specifically targets the second problem—how to measure the efficacy of an unlearning algorithm (since we provide the forget sets exactly)... The purview of TOFU also leaves out in-context unlearning.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: Our benchmark is designed to help researchers and practitioners think about and evaluate unlearning methods.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: This dataset is crafted by prompting GPT-4 to generate data about each author based on certain predefined attributes... our benchmark comes with three different splits. We include a 90-10 split, wherein the goal is to retain 90% and we hope to unleam the remaining 10%. Additionally, we have 95-5 and 99-1 splits, as well.
